name: Work Permit / Temporary Work Authorization

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must demonstrate the position cannot be filled by a national worker, submitting recruitment forecasts for both national and foreign positions to employment services. Foreign workers must hold at least technician-level qualifications. The Work Permit runs up to 2 years, renewable. Employers pay a 5,000 DA fiscal stamp fee per authorization and must notify employment services within 48 hours of contract termination, returning the permit within 15 days.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an Algerian job offer, have the employer justify the hire against the labor-market test, and obtain the Work Permit.

requirements.blocker_text: For assignments of 3 months or less, the Temporary Work Authorization (Autorisation Provisoire de Travail, APT) applies instead, renewable once per year.
requirements.fix_path: For a short-term (under 3 months) assignment, apply for the APT instead of the standard Work Permit.

evidence_required.document: Proof of technician-level or higher qualification

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years (Work Permit), renewable; up to 3 months, renewable annually (APT)

sources.title: Jeune Afrique (pan-African news outlet) -- Algeria's dual APT/Work Permit structure, labor-market test, qualification minimum, fees, employer obligations
